offering_description.value: Designs and supplies gaming terminals, virtual sports content and digital casino games to licensed betting operators and casinos. Sells business-to-business and earns through equipment placements, content licensing and revenue sharing on player wagers.

primary_products.value: gaming terminals; virtual sports content; digital casino games

primary_services.value: game content hosting; platform integration; terminal operations support

customer_segment.value: B2B: licensed betting operators, casinos, online gaming operators; B2G: state and national lottery operators

revenue_model.value: product sales: gaming terminals sold or placed with operators; licensing or royalties: content licensing fees from online and retail operators; transaction or usage fees: revenue share on bets placed on terminals and content
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds gaming terminals sold or placed with operators; software / platform: virtual sports and casino game platform licensed to betting operators

geography_served.value: global: UK, Europe, North America, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: gaming terminals, virtual sports and casino games sold to the same betting customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to betting operators and casinos; partners / resellers: content aggregators and platform partners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gambling licenses required in each jurisdiction, including UK Gambling Commission and US state gaming regulators
